High performance developer collaboration backend written in Python 3.12, utilizing Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, and Redis caching.

- Real-time DevSync Project Pulse activity timeline
- Strict role-based permissions matrix (Owner, Maintainer, Collaborator, Viewer)
